title: First Missing Positive
summary: Find the smallest positive integer absent from nums.
statement: Find the smallest positive integer absent from nums. Aim for linear time and constant auxiliary space, using the input array as working storage.

examples.explanation: All first three positive integers are present.
Neither the negative value nor the repeated 2 supplies 1.

constraints: 1–100000 signed 32-bit integers. Input may be reordered.
hints: Conceptual: With n values, the answer cannot exceed n+1.
Directional: Only values in [1,n] need a slot.
Implementation: Swap each useful value v toward position v−1 unless that position already contains v. Scan for the first mismatch.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space in mutable representations.
